data.reason: The third review returned six findings. F1, high: nothing tells the implementer to pass --model, so the declaration the amended criterion 3 rests on is never made and the gate falls back to the log, which reports the parent's model; the gate's half landed and the instruction half did not. F2: the tdd advance closes a window at last + 1 with no bound, so slice 4 of this ticket swallows all four review rounds at 253,085 tokens against a 2-point slice, and a reworked ticket's second advance keys a position that does not exist and drops its tokens, which makes a reworked route look cheaper. F3 to F6 are recorded and carried to a follow-up ticket on Ruud's decision.
